exercises.name: Halo
exercises.summary: Circle the bell around your head to open the shoulders and upper back.
cues: Hold the bell upside down by the horns
Keep it close to your head
Squeeze glutes, brace the core
Switch direction each lap

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.summary: Wakes up the glutes before hinging.
cues: Feet flat, knees bent
Drive through the heels
Squeeze hard at the top
Ribs down, don't arch the low back

exercises.name: Hip Hinge Drill
exercises.summary: Bodyweight hinge to groove the swing and deadlift pattern.
cues: Push hips back like closing a car door
Soft knees, flat back
Feel the hamstrings load
Stand tall by squeezing the glutes

exercises.name: Prying Goblet Squat
exercises.summary: Sit in the bottom of a goblet squat and gently pry the hips open.
cues: Bell at the chest
Elbows inside the knees
Shift side to side slowly
Chest proud

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.summary: Opens the front of the hips after hinging.
cues: Kneel on one knee
Tuck the pelvis, squeeze the back glute
Reach the same-side arm overhead

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.summary: Gentle standing or seated hamstring stretch.
cues: Hinge from the hips
Long spine
Breathe slowly into the stretch

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.summary: Relax the back and shoulders.
cues: Knees wide, hips to heels
Reach the arms long
Slow breathing through the nose

exercises.name: Crocodile Breathing
exercises.summary: Face-down belly breathing to bring the heart rate down.
cues: Forehead on your hands
Breathe in through the nose for 4
Feel your belly press into the floor
Long slow exhale

exercises.name: KB Swing (2-hand)
exercises.summary: The foundation of kettlebell training: explosive hip power for strength and conditioning.
cues: Hike the bell back high between the legs
Snap the hips, squeeze the glutes
Bell floats to chest height; arms are ropes
Stand up tall at the top
Keep it dynamic, control the bell

exercises.name: One-Arm Swing
exercises.summary: A swing with one hand: more grip and anti-rotation core work.
cues: Square shoulders, don't let the bell twist you
Same hip snap as the two-hand swing
Free hand guards the hip or mirrors the bell

exercises.name: KB Deadlift
exercises.summary: Foundational hinge for the back of the body.
cues: Bell between the feet, under the hips
Hinge back with a flat back
Push the floor away
Stand tall, don't lean back

exercises.name: KB Deadlift (2 bells)
exercises.summary: Deadlift with a bell beside each foot for heavier loading.
cues: Bells beside the feet, handles in line with ankles
Hinge, flat back, grip hard
2–3 sec slow lowering
Pick up and put down on the same spot

exercises.name: KB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.summary: Hamstring-focused hinge that starts from standing.
cues: Chest up, shoulders back
Push the hips back, soft knees
Find the big hamstring stretch
Bell stays close to the legs

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift
exercises.summary: One-leg hinge for balance, hips and hamstrings.
cues: Bell in the hand opposite the standing leg
Reach the back leg long like a see-saw
Hips stay square to the floor
Stand tall with a glute squeeze

exercises.name: KB Goblet Squat
exercises.summary: Front-loaded squat for legs and core.
cues: Bell at the chest, elbows down
Slowly lower to your deepest position
Hold the bottom for a second
Drive up through the whole foot

exercises.name: KB Front Rack Squat
exercises.summary: Single-bell squat from the rack position — great for the core.
cues: Bell in the rack, wrist straight
Don't lean toward the bell
Slowly lower, pause at the bottom
Drive up tall

exercises.name: KB Reverse Lunge (Goblet)
exercises.summary: Step-back lunges holding the bell at the chest.
cues: Step back softly
Back knee gently touches the ground
Front shin roughly vertical
Drive up through the front heel

exercises.name: KB Split Squat
exercises.summary: Static lunge: stay in a split stance and go straight down and up.
cues: Long split stance
Knee gently touches the ground
Torso tall
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch

exercises.name: Goblet Thruster
exercises.summary: Goblet squat straight into an overhead press. A big heart-rate driver.
cues: Squat with the bell at the chest
Drive up hard
Use the leg drive to press overhead
Lower to the chest, then squat

exercises.name: KB Strict Press
exercises.summary: Strict overhead press from the rack.
cues: Squeeze glutes and grip hard
Press up and slightly back
Lock out with the bicep by your ear
Slowly lower back to the rack

exercises.name: KB Press (Half Kneeling)
exercises.summary: Press from a half-kneeling stance. Removes the legs and challenges the core.
cues: Down knee on the same side as the bell
Squeeze the down-side glute
Lock out at the top
Slow lower back to the rack

exercises.name: KB Push Press
exercises.summary: A dip and drive from the legs to move a heavier bell overhead.
cues: Quick shallow dip
Drive through the legs
Punch the bell up to lockout
Lower under control to the rack

exercises.name: KB Floor Press
exercises.summary: Lying press for chest and triceps that's easy on the shoulders.
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent
Upper arm at 45°
Press straight up and lock out
Lower until the elbow touches the floor

exercises.name: KB Bridged Floor Press
exercises.summary: Floor press from a glute bridge for more range and glute work.
cues: Get into a bridge first
Press and hold at the top for a second
Lower slowly to the floor
Keep the hips high throughout

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.summary: Bodyweight press. Hands on a bench or the bell makes it easier.
cues: Hands under the shoulders
Body in one straight line
Elbows at 45°
Chest to the floor, then push it away

exercises.name: KB Bent Row
exercises.summary: Bent-over row for the back and grip.
cues: Staggered stance, free hand on thigh
Flat back
Pull the elbow to your hip pocket
Pause 1 sec at the top, lower slowly

exercises.name: KB High Pull
exercises.summary: Explosive hinge into a high row. Builds the upper back and power.
cues: Start like a swing
Snap the hips and pull the elbow high
Keep elbows high and grip soft
Let it swing back down under control

exercises.name: KB Clean
exercises.summary: Bring the bell from a swing to the rack position.
cues: Keep the bell close, zip up the jacket
Spear the hand through so it doesn't bang
Solid rack: wrist straight, elbow on ribs
Let it drop back into the hike

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
exercises.summary: Slow, controlled stand-up from the floor with the bell locked out overhead.
cues: Eyes on the bell the whole time
Arm locked, knuckles to the ceiling
Roll to elbow, then hand, then bridge high
Sweep the leg, kneel, stand. Reverse it slowly

exercises.name: Suitcase March
exercises.summary: March in place holding one bell. Builds anti-side-bend core strength.
cues: Stand tall, don't lean toward the bell
Knees to hip height
Shoulders level
Breathe behind the brace

exercises.name: Front Rack March
exercises.summary: March in place with the bell in the rack position.
cues: Solid rack, wrist straight
Tall posture
Slow, controlled knees

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.summary: Hard-style plank: maximal tension for a short time.
cues: Elbows under shoulders
Squeeze glutes and quads
Pull the elbows toward the toes
Breathe in short sips

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.summary: Side-on plank for the obliques and hips.
cues: Elbow under shoulder
Hips high, body in a line
Top hand on hip or reaching up

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.summary: Controlled core work that teaches bracing while moving.
cues: Low back pressed into the floor
Extend opposite arm and leg slowly
Exhale as you reach
Control, not speed

exercises.name: Clean → Squat → Press
exercises.summary: Clean to the rack, front squat, then press. One rep of each, then repeat.
cues: Clean, squat, press = one cycle
Keep cycling around
Switch hands each time
Smooth and steady beats fast and sloppy

exercises.name: Swings → Goblet Squats
exercises.summary: 10 swings straight into 5 goblet squats, then rest for the rest of the minute.
cues: Park the bell after the swings
Pick it up into the goblet position
Rest whatever is left of the minute

exercises.name: Armor Building Complex
exercises.summary: Dan John's classic: 2 cleans, 1 press, 3 front squats. One-bell version: switch sides each minute.
cues: 2 cleans
1 strict press
3 front rack squats
Rest for the rest of the minute

exercises.name: AMRAP Circuit
exercises.summary: Swings, goblet squats, push-ups and rows, round after round.
cues: 10 swings
8 goblet squats
6 push-ups
4 rows each arm
Keep a pace you can hold for 20 minutes

exercises.name: Swings + Push-Ups
exercises.summary: A pair: swings then push-ups.
cues: Swings first, then drop for push-ups
Keep push-ups strict
